''See also: [[Nye essence Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Nye]] essence is the fundamental core of life and power for [[the Nye]], a race of humanoid entities composed entirely of Shadow{{!}}shadow and cloth rather than flesh. This essence serves as the source of their unique abilities, which include moving with great speed, walking unseen, and running lightly. When utilized by others, the essence manifests as a cool, blue-white, or moonlight-like power that is inhaled into the lungs. Upon consumption, it provides the user with enhanced coordination, grace, and heightened reaction times, effectively slowing down the perception of the surrounding world. This temporal dilation allows a user to observe movements—such as flying arrows or striking enemies—as if they were moving through thick honey. While the essence grants significant physical advantages, it is a finite resource that eventually wanes or must be released, and its use can be physically taxing.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|[[The Nye]] essence is a type of power that [[Simon]] utilizes, providing a chill that imbues the user with increased speed. While drawing on this essence can make [[Simon]]'s lungs feel as though they are burning with ice, he has used it to fill his lungs in the past. Although [[Simon]] lacks the reflexes typically provided by this power, he can call upon it to slow down time and make a [[giant]] lizard feel as if it is pushing through jelly. Because the essence is a power that can fade, [[Simon]] must hold onto it in order to follow [[the Nye]]. Ultimately, [[Simon]] draws on the essence to match the [[steel]] within him.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|[[Nye]] essence is a specific type of essence that produces a sensation similar to inhaling a blizzard and carries the risk of freezing one's lungs. [[Simon]] utilizes this power to enhance his combat abilities, using it to land hits on [[Chaka]], power his physical movements, and slip in and out of battle. The essence grants [[Simon]] the ability to slow the world around him, though he must eventually find ways to restore his supply. Other individuals demonstrate unique interactions with the substance, such as [[Indirial]] using it for high-speed movement and [[Valin]] summoning it, which causes his own [[blood]] drops to hang oddly in the air.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[The Nye]] possess a unique essence that [[Simon]] is able to perceive and utilize. When called upon, this energy causes a chill in the lungs and slows the perception of time, making an instant feel much longer. While [[Simon]] himself does not possess this power, [[Indirial]] does, and its effects can be seen in individuals who move with unnatural speed and grace. The essence can roar into the lungs like a freezing hurricane, allowing for a casual glide, though releasing it returns the world to near-normal speed.}}
